Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Gyanendra Kumar Mishra,Ramesh Kumar Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Ramesh Kumar Sahu Hon'ble Shiv Shanker Prasad,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants to quash the impugned charge sheet dated 06.12.2017 as well as supplementary charge sheet dated 04.01.2018 and cognizance order dated 05.07.2018 as well as Non Bailable Warrant dated 18.08.2021 in Case No.
43543 of 2018 (State Vs. Masqoor Ali and Others) arising out of Case Crime No. 69 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and Section - 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station - Moolganj, District - Kanpur Nagar, pending in the Court of Metropolitan Magistrate 7th, Kanpur Nagar.

sentences.text: Having heard the learned counsel for the applicants and perused the materials brought on record, it does not appear to be a fit case praying for quashing of impugned order, charge-sheet and entire proceedings of criminal case.
The prayer praying for quashing of same is hereby refused, at this stage as the argument raised by learned counsel for the applicants involves factual disputes and appraisal of evidence.

However, looking at the nature of offence alleged and attending facts and circumstances of the case,
as have been brought on record, it is directed that if the applicants appear and surrender before the court below within two weeks from today and applies for bail, his prayer for bail shall be considered and decided in accordance with law.
For a period of two weeks from today, the non-bailable warrant issued against the applicants shall be kept in abeyance.
The present application stands disposed of.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
The contention of learned counsel for the applicants is that no offence against the applicants is disclosed and the present prosecution has been instituted with a malafide intention for the purpose of causing harassment.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:

The prayer praying for quashing of same is hereby refused, at this stage as the argument raised by learned counsel for the applicants involves factual disputes and appraisal of evidence.
